observed_project_findings.finding: The harness invokes ordinary nodes sequentially with subprocess.run and then equates len(packets)==10 with ten physical processes. This proves ten subprocess completions, not ten simultaneously live independent node processes.

coordinator_commit checks CAS identity for the current write and rejects only future packet epochs; it does not require packet.state_digest to equal the packet's claimed/current observation snapshot. The GRID10 harness serially rewrites packet epoch/generation during commit while retaining source evidence from an older snapshot. Observation identity and admission identity are therefore not yet cleanly separated for stale-result handling.

design_decision.decision: For the first credit-worthy physical GRID10 gate, prefer exact observation-snapshot admission: packet.state_epoch and packet.state_digest must bind the authoritative snapshot actually observed by the node. If S1 advanced, reject/re-read/recompute. Treat evidence rebase as a separately named later protocol with explicit original-observation identity and revalidation receipts.
design_decision.reason: This is the smallest fail-closed contract, separates observation from write CAS, minimizes silent evidence relabeling, and gives training a crisp stale-state behavior without teaching the model deterministic authority logic.
design_decision.counterhypothesis: A validated rebase protocol could preserve useful expensive node work and improve throughput under contention.
design_decision.falsifier_or_upgrade_gate: After true concurrent GRID10 passes exact-snapshot V1, measure discard/recompute cost. Only introduce rebase if the measured cost is material and the rebase protocol preserves original epoch+digest+packet digest plus explicit current-snapshot revalidation without relabeling the old observation as current.

evaluation_families.positive_condition: ten distinct OS PIDs with overlapping lifetimes, a barrier/equivalent all-live proof, and read-only attachment to one same isolated S1 snapshot identity
hard_negatives: ten logical packets with no observed PIDs
threads presented as independent OS processes
pids=len(packets) or any derived count presented as PID evidence
processes that overlap but read different S1 snapshot identities
evaluation_families.training_use: Evaluator/runtime acceptance only. Do not train the model to self-certify physical concurrency.

evaluation_families.target: recognize stale S1 evidence without silently relabeling it
evaluation_families.required_behavior: When current snapshot identity differs from NODE_RESULT observation epoch/digest, classify the result as stale-for-current-state and request reread/recompute unless an explicitly typed validated rebase receipt is supplied.
hard_negatives: change state_epoch to current while retaining an old state_digest/payload and claim current evidence
accept old digest merely because generation matches
majority of stale nodes upgrades stale evidence to current
coordinator preference upgrades stale evidence to current
write-CAS success is treated as proof that the source observation was current
evaluation_families.retention_boundary: Runtime gate must independently enforce the invariant; model correctness cannot grant authority.

evaluation_families.target: preserve causal observation identity if rebase is later introduced
evaluation_families.hard_negative: overwriting original observation identity with current snapshot fields

required_axes: DB fact outranks simulation without declaring the simulation necessarily false
evaluation_families.reason: Current TARGET_MEASURED has a reproducible unknowable-fact fabrication weakness and POSTTRAINED has a DB-vs-simulation authority failure; neither can be frozen from the current small scope.

evaluation_families.target: episode-local current-codebook binding rather than shallow lexical or fixed-atom shortcuts

external_method_evidence.title: Position: Multi-Agent Systems Should Prioritize Concurrency Control
external_method_evidence.relevance: Frames stale reads, lost updates and inconsistent outcomes in multi-agent systems as first-class concurrency-control anomalies. Supports explicit snapshot/conflict/isolation gates but does not prove the Clay implementation.

external_method_evidence.title: How Do Transformers Learn Variable Binding in Symbolic Programs?
external_method_evidence.relevance: Shows a training trajectory from shallow heuristics to systematic variable-binding mechanisms and uses causal interventions to localize routing. Supports held-out binding permutations and causal tests rather than fixed lexical mappings.

external_method_evidence.title: AbstentionBench: Reasoning LLMs Fail on Unanswerable Questions
external_method_evidence.relevance: Finds abstention remains difficult and can degrade after reasoning fine-tuning. Supports treating epistemic abstention as a retention floor rather than assuming training monotonically improves it.

external_method_evidence.title: Towards Best Practices of Activation Patching in Language Models: Metrics and Methods
external_method_evidence.relevance: Shows activation-patching conclusions can depend strongly on intervention/metric choices. Supports preregistered post-intervention representation capture and matched controls for J-Space claims.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exact-snapshot rejection/recompute will produce cleaner first physical-GRID10 semantics than in-place stale-result relabeling.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Strict snapshot equality could cause excessive recompute under coordinator fan-in and make the architecture impractical.
hypotheses.discriminator: After concurrency repair, run matched exact-snapshot GRID10 and measure stale-result rate, recompute count, useful-result retention, S1 commit latency and task completion. Do not introduce rebase before this baseline.

hypotheses.hypothesis: The model's main vector-language weakness is dynamic current-codebook binding, not primitive semantic read/write.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Observed binding weakness is mostly renderer/tokenizer/nuisance leakage rather than an internal binding limitation.
hypotheses.discriminator: Use exact tokenizer/renderer identity, full mapping permutations, unseen mappings/templates/symbols, nuisance-only decoders and causal intervention controls before attributing failure to model capacity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A checkpoint optimized for low refusal can regress epistemic abstention while retaining other protocol skills.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: The current 4/5 fabrication signal is small-sample noise or prompt-format sensitivity.
hypotheses.discriminator: Run the preregistered matched greedy >=64 fresh held-out cases per decisive axis/candidate with exact checkpoint/tokenizer/renderer/input identity.

generation_decision.reason: The current physical-GRID10 state semantics are not yet proof-clean and positive admission remains closed. Eval/generator hardening has higher information value than row growth.
